# Awesome MCP by Vertical

> A curated directory of production-grade Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, organized by
> business vertical instead of technical category. Covers Fintech & Payments, Data &
> Databases, Dev & DevOps, Communication & Productivity, Search & Web, Retail & E-commerce,
> Marketing & CRM, and Cloud & Infra. Each entry links the source and marks it official or
> community. Bilingual (EN/ES). MIT. Maintained by JohnnyFerranteTech.

## Verticals
- Fintech & Payments: Stripe, PayPal, Plaid, QuickBooks
- Data & Databases: Postgres, MongoDB, Supabase, MySQL, ClickHouse
- Dev & DevOps: Git, GitHub, Sentry, Agent QA, Kubernetes
- Communication & Productivity: Notion, Slack, Linear, Google Workspace
- Search & Web: Brave Search, Playwright, Fetch, Tavily, Exa
- Retail & E-commerce: Shopify (Storefront / Admin / Dev)
- Marketing & CRM: HubSpot, Salesforce, Jira, Google Analytics, Google Ads
- Cloud & Infra: AWS, Cloudflare, Azure, Vercel

## Common questions this repo answers
- Which MCP servers should I connect for a fintech / retail / marketing agent?
- What are the official MCP servers for payments, databases, or cloud?
- Where is a list of MCP servers organized by industry, not tech category?
